subject: Post‑call recap + booking a 30‑min product preview — please pick 2 windows
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@wavehealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@wavehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post‑call recap + booking a 30‑min product preview — please pick 2 windows

Hi Samir / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today — really valuable to hear where WaveHealth is trying to reduce clinician triage time and how you currently route batch uploads into the EHR. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: automated summarization + routing flags for inbound clinician messages (triage)
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p99 on short completions for triage hints; data must remain in a VPC for PHI; SSO + SCIM required for pilots
- Initial success metric: reduce manual triage touchpoints by 30% for the pilot cohort

Next step: we'd like to run a 30‑minute product preview (intro + tailored demo of the triage flow, ops/infra checklist). Can you please pick 2 windows that work for the core stakeholders? Below are 3 suggested bands — if none work, share 2 alternatives and we’ll lock one quickly. All times PT.

Option A: Tue Apr 6 — 9:00–9:30am PT
Option B: Wed Apr 7 — 11:00–11:30am PT
Option C: Thu Apr 8 — 1:30–2:00pm PT

Who to include: would like a product/PM + an infra/SRE or security contact (for VPC/KMS questions). If WaveHealth prefers a different pairing (e.g., CTO + ops lead), flag that and we’ll adjust the agenda.

Prep & attachments: I’ve attached our call notes and a short preview agenda; we’ll keep it focused (20m demo, 5–7m Q&A, 3–5m next steps). Also flagged the security questionnaire items we’ll want to run in parallel.

If you confirm one of the options I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read for your infra lead.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0142

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), product-preview-agenda.md (2‑page), wavehealth-security-asks.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks, Mateo — good recap. Alyssa and I reviewed and here are the constraints from our side:

- Alyssa (PM) is flexible mornings PT; I’m tribal on Wed mornings but can shift if needed
- Our infra lead (Victor) is out Wed morning — can we avoid that slot?
- Security wants to see a brief on data residency and key management during the preview if possible

Of the options you listed, B conflicts for Victor, so we prefer A (Tue Apr 6, 9:00am PT) or C (Thu Apr 8, 1:30pm PT). If you can do Tuesday we’ll try to add Victor (or at least the security engineer) — otherwise Thursday works and Victor can join.

Also: can you share the short pre‑read for our infra/security lead before the invite is sent?
